question: Direction of rotation of armature of motor can be found with the help of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fleming's left-hand rule**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fleming's left-hand rule** is used to determine the direction of rotation of the armature in a motor.
